about: Two example calls for each tool's card (tool_find { card }): plain, every input with no context, and ready, the same call filled from the open document (=facts.… as in nexthint.json). Each is one flat step. A value to give is marked. fill: each value to give (keep: true, a worked value to change). Owner, 22 Nov, 26 Nov.

pd_body_new.source: the tool's card and schema (tools.json); worked values written for this file

fill.what: XY, XZ, YZ; or, in place of plane, face: { side: "+z" } or { at, normal }

sketch_new.source: the tool's card and schema (tools.json); worked values written for this file

fill.what: the shape: rectangle, circle, line, arc … Its own inputs stand beside it; the description lists them for each kind
[x, y] in the sketch's own x/y, mm

sketch_add.source: the tool's card and schema (tools.json); worked values written for this file

fill.what: coincident, tangent, distance, radius …; the description lists each type with its refs
a ref is a geometry id g, or a point [g, vertex] (vertex 1 start, 2 end, 3 centre); here line 0 is 40 mm long
mm, or deg for angle; only the sizes take it
